svg.title: MetaHarness: the capability walkthrough
svg.desc: An animated nineteen-chapter walkthrough of repository analysis, Studio, scaffolding, hosts, templates, MCP governance, memory, routing, Darwin, AVO, field memory, Weight-EFT, experimental ARC, verification, publishing and benchmarks. Each chapter lasts nine seconds. Reduced motion shows an overview. Sources: repository README and documentation, October 6, 2026.

g.text: Build a harness you own. Keep the model replaceable.
Static analysis turns project structure into a starting plan.
README.md · Score any repo; USAGE.md · genome
A local browser workflow, with public repo data fetched from GitHub.
USERGUIDE.md · What can I do with it?
Generate a focused starting point, then make it yours.
Choose a focused workflow instead of shipping every tool.
Domain agents, skills and commands remain yours to customize.
MCP is an adapter surface, with access denied by default.
README.md · MCP; Prime Agent deny-lists require a sandbox
Project memory and peer coordination are explicit capabilities.
Learn routing decisions from your own evaluation outcomes.
README.md · router; gains depend on workload
Keep model weights frozen while testing harness changes.
AVO adds a governed inspect, edit, execute and repair loop.
README.md · AVO; stronger performance claim remains gated
Field memory is opt-in and requires deployment configuration.
README.md · field-memory; experimental, off by default
An optional weight-tuning path complements harness evolution.
README.md · Weight-EFT; GPU-gated, no universal gain promised
ARC-AGI-3 controller plus remote MCP and an Apps canvas.
README.md · private / experimental; no ARC performance claim
Use focused checks before trusting or publishing a harness.
harness validate · harness audit · harness sbom
Keep ownership while preserving evidence and update paths.
harness sign · harness verify · harness upgrade
Opt into recoverable sessions and inspect the tools you expose.
Evaluate quality and cost on your own work. Then ship.
README.md · Quality gates / leaderboard; open Studio to start
A factory for custom agent harnesses you own.
Analyze repos · Scaffold agents · Browser Studio
Host adapters · Domain templates · MCP policy
